"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Israel’s three-week military operation was an excessive and inhumane response to Hamas’s rocket launchings into Israeli population centers.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Israel’s three-week military operation did little to enhance the long-term security of the Israeli people.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Ehud Olmert admits Israel can neither gain physical security nor perpetuate its status as a majority Jewish state unless it ends its unjust occupation of the Gaza Strip and West Bank.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America urges the U.S. government and the international community to ensure that the temporary ceasefire in Gaza leads to a sustained diplomatic effort to negotiate a just, two-state solution to the conflict between the Palestinian and Israeli peoples.",

```
